raw_segments.text: If I could do that and nothing else, you wouldn't be needed to pull the big guns at all.
If I was like my captain he can see things inside his head before the firing begins,
and he shakes all over, but he knows too much to run away if I was like him I could
But if I were as wise as all that I should never be here.
I should be a king in the forest, as I used to be, sleeping half the day and bathing when
I haven't had a good bath for a month.
